rolesSection.subtitle: Each role is specialised – together they cover your team's everyday work. Roles without "coming soon" are ready to use today.

faqItems.a: Technical setup per agency (your own domain, your own branding, your own assistant name) is done in days, not months — once your domain points to our server via DNS, the rest is a short, standardized process. No months-long development project like building it yourself.

faqItems.q: Will our customers see "ki-works" or "Kiwo" anywhere?
faqItems.a: No. Your own domain, your own logo/colors/product name, and an assistant name you choose — for your customers, ki-works is invisible as the technology supplier.

faqItems.q: Do we keep the customer relationship?
faqItems.a: Yes, throughout. You create and manage your customers yourself in your own login — we only deliver the technology in the background, with no direct line to your end customers.
Tiered partner terms depending on your number of end customers — we'll discuss the details in a personal conversation, tailored to your customer base. No fixed price sheet.
EU hosting and TLS-encrypted transmission, strict data separation between the customers of different agencies. We're happy to discuss details for your own review in a conversation.

faqItems.q: Do we have to build or maintain anything ourselves?
faqItems.a: No. No own Vapi/Anthropic setup, no own server infrastructure, no support for the core technology — that's all handled on our end.

s8.title: 8. Cookies
s8.text: This website does not use analytics or tracking cookies. For technically necessary settings (e.g. your theme or language choice, your login to the customer dashboard) we use only local browser storage (localStorage) — unlike a cookie, this does not automatically send data to our server and therefore does not require consent. Via the cookie banner or the "Cookie settings" link in the footer, you can still choose between "necessary only" and "accept all" — as a precaution in case we use analytics or marketing services in the future. You can change your choice there at any time.

s9.title: 9. AI transparency
s9.text: Conversations with our AI roles (e.g. taking phone reservations) are clearly identified to guests at the start of the call as automated, AI-powered communication (Art. 50 EU AI Act). ki-works provides the business with the corresponding notice text.
